title: Low Tide: Months Reaching
statement: Tessera set the second month under the first and left it rootless. Beatriz wanted it to reach up. So the paper-coloured month now sends roots upward, against gravity and against sense, toward the brown roots hanging from the month above, and at three mornings only, the fifth, the fourteenth and the twenty-second, the two sets touch. Where they touch I have put a point of hot pink, because a record touching another record is not a tender event, whatever the room thinks; it is a short circuit. Between the eighth and ninth mornings two roots have fused into a loop and feed only each other. Everything else is Tessera's. The next hand can cut the loop, or wait for the third month to reach up from below.
process: I kept Tessera's two-month record exactly, the rooted first month, the second line with its dots and the linking verticals, and added upward hand-drawn roots from every morning of the second month, three of them long enough to reach the first month's roots and marked at the contact with pink points and rings, plus one pink loop fusing two adjacent roots.

proposal.direction: Let the second month take root too, but upward: its roots grow from the paper-coloured line toward the first month's roots above, and where the two sets meet, let them touch at two or three mornings only.
proposal.rationale: Records kept together grow toward each other; second attempt, and after the first person walked out onto the flat the room wanted the ledger to answer with something tender.
